launches.desc: VIctory (Xbox Series compatibility layer) tuned for NVIDIA RTX cards: Series X at 2560x1440 with DLSS, about 26-30 fps on an RTX 5070, DLSS frame generation 2x-6x, an F1 settings menu and F3 stats panel, open water without dark blocks.
